data.description:
hellomed ist die digitale Pflege-Apotheke für Pflegekräfte - nach dem Motto: Dauermedikation nur in einfach!

Unsere Vision ist es, bis 2030 die jährlichen 250.000 Krankenhauseinlieferungen aufgrund von Medikationsfehlern und die damit verbundenen 1,2 Milliarden Euro Folgekosten zu vermeiden und der Pflege wieder zurückzugeben.

Mit unserer innovativen hellomedOS-Software für das Pflegepersonal entlasten wir Pflegekräfte bei der täglichen Medikationsversorgung ihrer Patienten und machen diese noch sicherer. Unser revolutionäres Konzept bringen wir mit einem bunten Team aus Apothekern, Pflegeexperten und Entwicklern auf die Straße - namhafte Investoren sind bereits mit an Bord und Pflegekräfte deutschlandweit lieben das Produkt. Erfinde gemeinsam mit uns die Medikationsversorgung in der Pflege von Morgen komplett neu!

Für unsere größten Kunden – Träger und Pflegeunternehmen mit mehreren Standorten – suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die diese Partnerschaften betreut, ausbaut und unsere Kundenbetreuung mit uns gemeinsam weiterentwickelt.

Aufgaben

  • Großkunden betreuen: Du betreust unsere größten Pflegeunternehmen und Träger – von der Einführung bis zur langfristigen Zusammenarbeit – und bist feste Ansprechperson für Geschäftsführungen, Regional- und Pflegedienstleitungen.

  • Versorgung im Alltag sichern: Du sorgst dafür, dass alle vereinbarten Patienten auch tatsächlich über hellomed versorgt werden, und schulst Pflegeteams und Leitungen im sicheren Umgang mit hellomedOS – vor Ort und digital.

  • Kundenbeziehungen ausbauen: Du erkennst, wo wir bei bestehenden Kunden weitere Standorte und Patienten versorgen können, und setzt das gemeinsam mit unserem Vertrieb um. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich im Wachstum deiner Kundenbeziehungen.

  • Gespräche auf Leitungsebene: Du führst regelmäßige Gespräche mit den Geschäftsführungen deiner Kunden – was läuft gut, wo gibt es Potenzial, was braucht der Kunde als Nächstes?

  • Kundenbetreuung mitgestalten: Gemeinsam mit den Gründern entwickelst du unsere Abläufe in der Kundenbetreuung weiter und gibst deine Erfahrung an Kollegen im Team weiter.

  • Verantwortung übernehmen: Mit wachsendem Team übernimmst du zunehmend Verantwortung für unsere gesamte Customer-Success-Funktion.

  • Mit deiner Arbeit hilfst du dabei, unsere Vision zu verwirklichen und die Medikationsversorgung in der Pflege nachhaltig zu verbessern.

Qualifikation

  • Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Betreuung oder im Ausbau von Geschäftskunden mit, zum Beispiel als Key Account Manager, Kundenbetreuer oder im Vertrieb, idealerweise im Gesundheitswesen. Alternativ hast du Leitungserfahrung in der Pflege (z. B. als Pflegedienst-, Einrichtungs- oder Regionalleitung) und Freude an Kundenkontakt und Wachstum.

  • Erfahrung mit großen Kunden: Du hast bereits Kunden mit mehreren Standorten betreut und trittst gegenüber Geschäftsführungen sicher und überzeugend auf.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du erklärst komplexe Sachverhalte klar und verständlich und baust schnell Vertrauen auf – bei Pflegekräften ebenso wie bei Geschäftsführern.

  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest zuverlässig und organisiert, behältst auch bei mehreren großen Kunden den Überblick und hast ein gutes Gespür für Zahlen.

  • Technische Offenheit: Du arbeitest sicher mit digitalen Anwendungen. Erfahrung mit einem CRM-System oder Pflegesoftware ist von Vorteil.

  • Reisebereitschaft: Du besuchst unsere Kunden regelmäßig vor Ort (max. 1/3 der Arbeitszeit).

  • Haltung statt Lebenslauf: Startup-Erfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung – entscheidend sind deine Erfahrung und dein Anspruch an gute Kundenbetreuung.

Benefits

  • Wir bieten dir einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag mit Arbeitsplatz in unserem brandneuen Büro am Mehringdamm im Herzen Berlin-Kreuzbergs, mit guter Verkehrsanbindung.

  • Du profitierst von einer überdurchschnittlichen Bezahlung mit attraktiver Bonuskomponente, die sich am Wachstum deiner Kundenbeziehungen orientiert.

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für eine ganze Funktion und arbeitest direkt an der Seite der hellomed-Gründer – mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und viel Freiraum für eigene Ideen.

  • Du erhältst monatlich 50 € steuerfreien Sachbezug (gesetzlicher Höchstbetrag), frei einlösbar bei über 100 Marken wie Amazon, REWE, IKEA oder Urban Sports Club. Alternativ erstatten wir dir dein Deutschlandticket.

  • Wir verstehen, dass das Leben flexibel sein muss. Daher bieten wir dir flexible Arbeitszeiten mit 2 Tagen Home-Office pro Woche in einer geregelten 5-Tage-Woche.

  • Bei Bedarf stellen wir dir einen Dienstwagen oder eine Bahncard zur Verfügung, um dich bei Kundenterminen und Reisen optimal zu unterstützen.

  • Du hast 27 Urlaubstage plus einen zusätzlichen Tag für jedes Jahr Betriebszugehörigkeit.

  • Wir versorgen dich täglich mit Getränken, und bei regelmäßigen Teamevents sorgen wir für unvergessliche gemeinsame Momente.

  • Deine persönliche Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen. Du hast jederzeit die Möglichkeit, dich weiterzubilden oder Schulungen zu besuchen.

Hast du Interesse? Dann bewirb dich direkt über unser Online-Formular auf JOIN.

data.description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

DIRECTOR – EUROPEAN GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS

As the Director – European Government Operations, based in Munich/ Berlin, Germany, you will lead Rocket Lab's government affairs strategy across Germany and the broader European region. You will play a critical role in advancing Rocket Lab's business objectives by shaping policy environments, building strategic government relationships, and ensuring alignment between Government Affairs and Business Development. In this role, you will work at the intersection of aerospace innovation, national security, and European public-sector engagement. To be successful, you must be results‑oriented, proactive, politically astute, and deeply comfortable operating in complex, fast‑moving environments. Join a driven team of pioneers relentlessly tackling challenging projects, delivering on the impossible, and making an impact on the future of space.

WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO

  • Build and lead Rocket Lab's in‑house European Government Operations function, delivering the same level of strategic support and government engagement the company receives in the U.S. market
  • Develop and lead Rocket Lab's government affairs strategy in Germany and across Europe, ensuring alignment with corporate priorities and business development objectives
  • Build and maintain high‑impact relationships with key German federal stakeholders, including the Bundestag, DLR, Ministry of Defense, and relevant regulatory and executive agencies
  • Establish and grow Rocket Lab's presence with government entities and innovation ecosystems in Munich and other strategic European hubs
  • Partner closely with the Business Development team to support market expansion, customer engagement, and pursuit of government‑funded programs
  • Shape and influence policy discussions related to space, defense, launch, and emerging technologies, ensuring Rocket Lab's interests are represented and understood
  • Provide strategic guidance on political, regulatory, and industrial‑policy developments across Europe, identifying opportunities and risks for business
  • Represent Rocket Lab in industry associations, working groups, and public‑sector forums to strengthen the company's visibility and credibility
  • Drive measurable business outcomes through targeted government engagement not only monitoring policy trends but actively shaping them
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on European political dynamics, defense priorities, and government procurement pathways

YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in political science, international relations, public policy, law, economics, engineering, or a related field
  • 12+ years of experience in government affairs, public policy, defense, aerospace, or related strategic roles within Germany or Europe
  • Professional fluency in German and English
  • Demonstrated success building and managing relationships with senior government officials, policymakers, and public‑sector institutions
  • Proven ability to drive business‑aligned outcomes through government engagement, not solely policy monitoring
  • Strong understanding of European political structures, defense priorities, and government procurement processes
  • Ability to operate autonomously, set strategy, and execute in a fast‑paced, high‑growth environment
  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and stakeholder‑management skills

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE

  • Background in space, aerospace, defense, or dual‑use technology sectors
  • Experience working with or within institutions such as DLR, MOD, Bundestag committees, EU defense bodies, or national innovation agencies
  • Prior roles in business development, defense industrial policy, or public‑sector consulting
  • Experience working in Munich's government, defense, or technology ecosystem
  • Familiarity with NATO, EU defense initiatives, and cross‑border industrial‑cooperation frameworks

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

 

WHAT TO EXPECT 

We're on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that's not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other's backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.   

Important information:

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR here.

Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process for a job in the United States should contact Giulia Johnson at

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY:

For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant.  These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations. 

Under these Regulations, you may be ineligible for this role if you do not hold citizenship of Australia, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland, the European Union, or a country that is part of NATO, or if you hold ineligible dual citizenship or nationality.  For more information on these Regulations, click here ITAR Regulations.

data.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.

Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.
  • Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why.
  • Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.
  • Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest:

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant.
  • You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them.
  • You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now.
  • You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions.
  • You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own.
  • You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all).
  • You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

data.description:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

We are now looking for an ambitious Engineering Manager - Robot Intelligence (m/f/d) to help us establish RobCo as a leading provider of autonomous automation solutions.

In this key role, you will lead the “brain” of our autonomous robots - the physical AI harness that works with different models and skills. Managing a full-stack team of software and machine learning engineers, you will balance applied research with business value delivery on a daily basis.

Your mission is to translate the latest advancements in physical AI foundation models and complex robotic functionality into a stable, scalable product that thrives in real-world factory environments.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Drive Engineering Excellence: Set rigorous standards for code quality, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines to ensure 24/7 reliability of our robots.

  • Lead Senior Talent: Act as a people-first leader for a team of Senior and Staff engineers, fostering a culture of high ownership and steady delivery.

  • Bridge Software and Hardware: Oversee the lifecycle of products spanning from ML training, AI inference to Linux-based industrial interfaces.

  • Balance Research and Delivery: Establish a strong applied research and experimentation culture, and build a process where the results directly contribute to delivery and practical outcomes.

  • Management Framework: Work with real-time metrics and steer the team to continuously improve productivity, predictability and quality of what we ship.

  • Operational Governance: Manage technical debt and architectural health to ensure long-term system stability as we scale.

  • Strategic Alignment: Partner with Product Management to transform customer needs into concrete technical requirements and actionable sprints.

  • Cross-Team Leadership: Mentor junior EMs and help evolve company-wide engineering best practices and software-first principles.

We are looking for someone who has:

  • Completed a university degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Engineering, Data Science or a related field.

  • 3+ years of experience leading high-performing teams in complex technical environments like robotics or industrial IoT.

  • Deep experience with AI and machine learning, including dataset curation, model training and optimization techniques and hands on experience building agentic harnesses.

  • Proven track record of driving an AI-first engineering culture and implementing agentic workflows that measurably accelerate team velocity and system efficiency.

  • Expert knowledge in modern SDLC practices, with a track record of improving deployment frequency and system stability.

  • Culture-aligned mindset characterized by hardware empathy, a passion for software-defined hardware, and a strong culture of high ownership.

  • Strong experience with full-stack software development, robotics engineering is a big plus.

  • Very good English skills with the ability to navigate complex architectural discussions with Staff engineers while clearly communicating risks to stakeholders.

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

  • Wellpass membership (7,200+ studios across Germany), regular team events, and a team that takes both the work and the culture seriously.

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and - depending on the role - the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events - from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that adapts to your use case, improves over time, and requires zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. With $160M raised from investors including Lightspeed, Lingotto Innovation, and Sequoia, 200+ people globally, and 2.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our RobCo Bay Area Demo Lab in San Francisco.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

data.description:
About RA

Resident Advisor has been a home for electronic music culture since 2001. Event discovery, ticketing, news and long-form editorial, artist profiles, original films, and a weekly mix series two decades deep. Around 7 million people use the web platform every month, with a wider audience across our apps and other channels. Underneath the platform sits a network of contributors and city managers across dozens of cities, which is how we stay connected to the scenes we cover rather than reporting on them from a distance. RA is 25 years old, independent, B.Corp certified and intent on being indispensable to the artists, promoters and audiences who make this culture.

Purpose of the role

As our Senior QA Engineer, you'll look after the quality of ra.co, our iOS and Android apps, and RA Scan, the app promoters use to scan tickets at the door. You'll work across five product teams. Each team writes and runs its own tests. You'll help them do it well, keep the automated test suites healthy, and test the riskiest releases yourself.

Some of what we ship carries real risk: payments, checkout, and getting people into venues on the night. Other changes are a line of copy. You'll help us tell the two apart and test each one accordingly. We use AI tools across development, and you'll help the teams use them to write better tests, faster.

Key responsibilities

  • Keep the web end-to-end test suite healthy: fix flaky tests, add coverage for new features, and make sure a failing suite gets fixed quickly
  • Grow automated testing for our iOS and Android apps and RA Scan with the app developers, so mobile tests run on every change
  • Test high-risk releases yourself, such as payments and checkout, including edge cases and what happens when things fail
  • Review the test plans teams write, and help them improve
  • Use AI tools to write and maintain tests, help developers do the same, and check what the tools produce
  • Brief our external testing partner and review the results they send back
  • Report bugs clearly, and follow them through with developers and product managers
  • Track a few simple measures, such as bugs that reach production and how reliable the automated tests are

We’re looking for

  • Several years in QA or test engineering, typically four or more, testing web and mobile products
  • Hands-on test automation: you've built and maintained automated tests that run in CI, for web (for example Playwright, Cypress or Selenium) and ideally mobile. We use XCUITest on iOS and Espresso with Kotlin on Android
  • Enough coding to write and fix tests alongside developers, in a language such as JavaScript, TypeScript, Kotlin or Swift
  • You can test APIs and check data with SQL
  • Good judgement about risk: what to test deeply, what lightly, and what not at all
  • You've used AI tools in your testing work, and know where they help and where they don't
  • Clear writing: bug reports and test plans other people can act on

If you meet most of these but not all, we'd still like to hear from you. Nobody arrives with all of it, and we'll help you grow into the rest.

Nice to have

  • CircleCI or a similar CI tool
  • Working with an external testing partner
  • Payments, checkout or ticketing systems
  • Testing apps used at live events, with poor networks
  • Test management tools such as Qase or TestRail

What we offer you

  • Generous annual leave policies aimed at promoting work-life balance.
  • Matched pension, or 401k for US staff.
  • Comprehensive staff wellbeing initiatives, featuring regular activities and workplace programmes to support mental and physical health. This includes discounted ClassPass memberships and custom-fitted earplugs.
  • Company-led social events, team lunches, and discounts on merch.
  • Paid annual volunteering allowance, encouraging contributions to community projects and charities you care about.
  • A transparent internal company culture committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion (see: https://ra.co/about/diversity).
  • Active involvement in community projects within the electronic music community (see: https://ra.co/about/community).

More about RA

We are independent and we intend to stay that way. 25 years in, RA answers to the culture it came from rather than to outside stakeholders. That is what enables us to make decisions on a long-term basis.

Our staff, contributors and international teams are not observers. They are part of the scenes we cover, and that is what we hire for. Craft first, and then a genuine stake in this music rather than just a job in it.

RA has been B Corp certified since 2024, which holds us to standards on social and environmental impact we would want to meet regardless of the badge.

We especially welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, abilities, ethnicities, experiences, gender identities, and sexual orientations.

Our values

  • Electronic music is art.
  • We celebrate the progressive values that underpin electronic music.
  • We advocate for a more inclusive and equitable electronic music community.
  • We honour the past, present and future of electronic music.
  • We use innovation to empower the community.
  • We choose honesty over gain and purpose over profit.
  • We're always front left.

Listing details

This role is a full-time, permanent position, based in Berlin. Please note: this position requires applicants to be based in Berlin and to work from the office three days per week. The annual salary range for this role is €60,000 to €72,000. If you have questions about the role, please contact

data.description:
Across Europe, fleets are under enormous pressure. Fuel costs are rising. Regulatory requirements are tightening. The shift to low-emission vehicles is accelerating. And yet around 70% of European businesses still manage their fleets manually, with spreadsheets, disconnected tools, and processes that were never built for this moment. Shiftmove exists to make this simple.

We are a profitable B2B SaaS company and the fastest-growing fleet management platform in Europe, born from the merger of Avrios and Vimcar, and now serving tens of thousands of corporate customers across Germany, France, Spain, Switzerland, Poland, and beyond. Most recently, we acquired Optimum and Ocean in France, expanding our footprint and doubling down on one of Europe's largest fleet markets. Our AI-powered platform connects real-time vehicle data with intelligent software so that businesses can procure smarter, control costs, stay compliant, and lead the transition to cleaner mobility, all from one place.

About the role:

We are looking for an experienced Interim Senior BI Analyst to join us on an initial three-month contract, with the option to extend for a further three months.

As we integrate two acquired French businesses into our group, we need to bring their data into our standard reporting while transforming how our executive team accesses and uses business intelligence. Our existing Tableau dashboards have evolved over time, and we see an opportunity to make them clearer, more consistent and more actionable.

Reporting to our VP of Operations, Data & BI, you will work closely with the executive team, Head of FP&A, RevOps and Data Engineering. You will take ownership of rebuilding our executive reporting, responding to daily analytical requests and ensuring that acquired-company data is accurately reflected in group-wide reporting.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong technical BI skills with commercial acumen, sound analytical judgement and the confidence to challenge senior stakeholders when the data tells a different story.

What You'll Do

  • Rebuild executive reporting: Audit our existing Tableau dashboards and the underlying business logic. Decide which dashboards to retain, consolidate, redesign or retire, and rebuild the priority dashboards so executives can quickly understand performance and make informed decisions
  • Establish consistent metrics: Document and align metric definitions to ensure that business performance is measured consistently across dashboards, teams and entities
  • Own daily ad hoc reporting: Manage requests through our Jira-based data support queue, prioritising, scoping and delivering analyses on a daily basis. Translate ambiguous requests into clear business questions and identify recurring needs that can be addressed through standard reporting
  • Integrate acquisition data: Partner with Data Engineering as acquired-company data is migrated into Snowflake. Validate and reconcile data against source systems, build and maintain dbt models, and incorporate the data into existing Tableau dashboards so group reporting reflects all entities
  • Deliver commercial insights: Translate executive requirements into meaningful analysis of go-to-market performance, including pipeline, bookings, ARR, retention and churn
  • Partner with Finance: Work closely with the Head of FP&A to reconcile BI reporting with financial figures and establish a consistent view of business performance
  • Present findings and challenge assumptions: Communicate insights directly to the executive team, explain what the data means for the business, and challenge assumptions where the evidence supports a different conclusion
  • Enable a smooth handover: Document dashboards, data models, metric definitions and reporting processes so the permanent BI team can take ownership of the work at the end of the interim period

What You Need to Succeed

  • You bring extensive experience in BI or analytics, including at least three years working at a senior level
  • You have expert-level Tableau dashboard development skills, including experience redesigning dashboards for executive audiences
  • You have strong SQL skills and hands-on experience working with Snowflake
  • You have practical experience with dbt, including building and maintaining data models, tests and documentation
  • You understand go-to-market performance and are fluent in metrics such as pipeline, bookings, ARR, net and gross retention, and churn
  • You have a track record of translating executive requirements into analysis that informs business decisions
  • You have experience integrating acquired, migrated or otherwise disparate data sources into existing reporting environments
  • You are comfortable managing a Jira ticket queue and delivering reporting requests within daily turnaround expectations
  • You communicate exceptionally well in written and spoken English and are confident presenting to C-level stakeholders, including challenging assumptions when the data warrants it
  • You are based in Europe and available to work 35 hours per week for the duration of the contract

Nice to have:

  • French or German language skills
  • Experience in a SaaS or subscription-based business
  • Experience working with Salesforce, HubSpot or NetSuite data models
  • Experience building a semantic layer or self-service analytics capabilities for executive stakeholders
  • Experience reporting to private equity investors or preparing board-level reporting packs

What Success Looks Like

We want you to make a tangible impact from the start

  • By Day 30: Complete an audit of existing dashboards and underlying business logic, with a clear recommendation to retain, consolidate, redesign or retire each dashboard. Take ownership of the Jira queue and establish a reliable daily delivery rhythm
  • By Day 90: Have the priority executive dashboards rebuilt and in use, agree metric definitions with the Head of FP&A, and bring the first acquired-company data into standard group reporting
  • By Day 180 (if extended): Complete the rebuild of all in-scope dashboards, incorporate all migrated acquisition data into standard reporting, convert recurring ad hoc requests into standard reports, and complete the handover to the permanent BI team

Why Shiftmove

Why should you join us? At Shiftmove, you can contribute to an established, product-led company focused on delivering real value to its customers, with meaningful recurring revenue and an ambitious agenda for growth

  • Autonomy: We bring you in for your expertise and give you the ownership and space to deliver meaningful results.
  • Impact: Play a direct role in shaping executive reporting and integrating acquired businesses into a consistent, group-wide view of performance
  • Fair and equitable compensation: Interim compensation will be discussed based on your expertise, experience and geographic location
  • Dog-friendly office: Because furry coworkers make everything better! 🐶

SOUNDS LIKE YOU?

If you don't tick all the boxes but believe you can thrive in this role, we would love to hear from you.

Shiftmove is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse experiences and demographic characteristics that have nurtured unique viewpoints benefit our growth and performance. Just be yourself, and maybe you'll bring something valuable to the role we didn't initially think of.

If you need specific accommodations (tools, time, etc.) due to any special needs, and you are happy to disclose this, please let us know. We are happy to make adjustments, as support can make a decisive difference in the application process.

der task

Creator Sourcing & Onboarding

you

At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

We're hiring an IT Program Manager who will be at the centre of how Moss buys, manages and eventually retires technology. You'll own the vendor and contract landscape, steer the Tech Operations budget, and lead the company-wide platform migrations and consolidations that come a few times a year.

You'll report to the CISO and work closely with our Tech Operations engineers and Information Security team, alongside Legal, People Ops and FP&A, across a technology estate spanning 350 people and five offices.

Your responsibilities

  • Own vendor and contract negotiations across Moss's SaaS, tooling, infrastructure and connectivity providers, running competitive evaluations to build commercial leverage and maintaining the renewal calendar and contract repository

  • Plan and steer the Tech Operations budget, creating cost transparency per team and driving licence right-sizing, optimisation and consolidation across the tool estate

  • Partner with teams across Moss to understand how tools are actually used, matching licence tiers to real usage and deciding which overlapping tools to keep based on what genuinely serves people, not just cost

  • Drive down the number of tools Moss runs by finding shadow IT, bringing it into the process or consolidating it, and owning retirement work together with Information Security

  • Lead company-wide technology migrations and retirements end to end, from business case and migration plan through cutover, communication and training

  • Bring structure to how work reaches Tech Operations, building a clear intake process and owning the KPIs and monthly management reporting for the domain

  • Work with Legal on contracts and DPAs and with People Ops on joiners and leavers, owning the commercial relationship and negotiation for the vendors in your portfolio within Moss's existing Vendor Management framework

About you

  • Several years of experience in IT vendor management, procurement, sourcing, tech operations or IT service management, ideally gained in a scaling company

  • Proven experience negotiating with vendors and providers, including on service levels and cost

  • Experience leading at least one company-wide tool migration or consolidation end to end, including decommissioning the old system

  • A hands-on IT background, enough to keep essential services running from documented runbooks in an emergency

  • AI is core to how we work. We expect someone with an "AI Driver" toolkit: measurable, real-workflow AI use with concrete before/after impact, ideally including built automations or agents (n8n, Claude skills, or similar).

  • German at C1 or above, prior experience in a regulated environment (financial services, payments or e-money), exposure to ISO 27001, SOC 2 or DORA, or an ITIL/IAITAM qualification are all a plus

In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for:

  • A talent for moving things forward through clarity and good process rather than hierarchy

  • Comfortable owning commercial outcomes inside a governance framework someone else owns

  • Genuine curiosity about how other teams work, and translating that into better commercial calls than a dashboard would

  • A structured, documentation-friendly way of working, with an instinct for turning manual work into something that runs itself

About Moss

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star.

We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA: playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect:

  • Top-of-market compensation package, including equity. 

  • Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos.

  • Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits.

Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).

By applying for the above position, you will confirm that you have reviewed and agreed to our Data Privacy Policy.

Projektmanager Photovoltaik (m/w/d)

Bei GALVANY ist es unser Ziel, klimaneutrales Wohnen für alle zur Realität zu machen. Wir setzen auf Umsetzung und entwickeln konkrete, smarte Lösungen, indem wir Wärmepumpen, Batteriespeicher und Smart Metering einfach zugänglich, zuverlässig und bezahlbar machen.

Wir sind ein profitables Greentech-Startup und glauben, dass nachhaltiger Impact und langfristiges Wachstum nur auf Basis eines gesunden Geschäftsmodells möglich sind. Um unsere ambitionierte Tech Roadmap umzusetzen haben wir im Frühjahr 2026 eine Seed-Finanzierung in Höhe von 10 Millionen Euro mit Set Ventures und AENU abgeschlossen. Getrieben von Kundennutzen, Klarheit und Verantwortung stehen wir für hochwertige Heizlösungen und ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen Verantwortung übernehmen und nachhaltigen Mehrwert schaffen.

Als Projektmanager Photovoltaik (m/w/d) verantwortest du die operative Steuerung unserer PV-Projekte von der Vertragsunterschrift bis zur fertigen Installation auf dem Dach. Du bringst unsere Kund:innen strukturiert, effizient und profitabel durch die gesamte Projektphase und koordinierst dabei eng mit unseren Lieferanten und Installationsbetrieben. Du arbeitest KPI-getrieben, greifst proaktiv ein und lässt kein Projekt liegen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du steuerst PV-Projekte aktiv von Unterschrift bis Abschluss mit dem Ziel, die Cycle Time konsequent zu reduzieren.

  • Du koordinierst den direkten, operativen Draht zu PV-Modul-Herstellern, Großhändlern und Installationsbetrieben und sorgst für reibungslose Abstimmung bei Beschaffung, Terminierung und Durchführung.

  • Du greifst proaktiv ein, sobald Zeit-KPIs überschritten werden oder Risiken für Durchlaufzeit, Profitabilität oder Kundenzufriedenheit entstehen.

  • Du gewährleistest, dass Projekte vollständig, baubar und jederzeit korrekt im System abgebildet sind und kein Projekt verloren geht.

  • Du behältst die Vollständigkeit der Projektunterlagen im Blick – erkennst frühzeitig, was fehlt, und sorgst dafür, dass es rechtzeitig vorliegt.

  • Du hast die Profitabilität pro Projekt im Griff: Engpässe und Wartezeiten identifizierst du rechtzeitig, bevor sie auf das Ergebnis drücken.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Customer Support Team zusammen und übernimmst die proaktive, projektspezifische Kommunikation zu definierten Kontaktpunkten.

  • Du schaffst transparente und aktuelle Projektstatus und gibst jederzeit Klarheit über Blocker und Handlungsbedarf.

  • Du baust die Prozesse für PV-Projekte aktiv mit auf und entwickelst sie kontinuierlich weiter, da es sie bei uns in dieser Form noch nicht gibt.

Dein Profil

  • Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung oder Studium in einem relevanten Bereich (z. B. Technik, Handwerk, Energie, Wirtschaft) oder vergleichbare Praxiserfahrung im Projekt- oder Operationsumfeld.

  • Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, in Operations oder in einem technischen Umfeld (z. B. Bau, Handwerk, Energie).

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift (C2).

  • Sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Systemen und digitalen Tools.

  • Erfahrung im Umfeld Photovoltaik, Wärmepumpe oder erneuerbare Energien ist ein Plus.

As Data Engineer on our Healthcare Platform, you will own the foundational data ingestion, entity-resolution, and platform infrastructure end-to-end. You will design and operate scalable batch/streaming data pipelines, harden platform orchestration, and ensure system reliability, security, and cost efficiency.

A central challenge of this role is building and operationalizing our unified healthcare data ontology—a consistent semantic model covering hospitals, departments, specialties, metrics, and classification standards. Working closely with Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, and Methodology experts, you will turn heterogeneous, multi-country hospital data into a coherent, highly queryable data asset.

Key Responsibilities

  • Data Contracts & Schema Governance: Establish strict data contracts (Pydantic, dbt contracts) and schema management, ensuring dataset reproducibility, data lineage tracking, and automated validation across all platform pipelines.

  • Platform Efficiency & Cloud Infrastructure: Optimize data storage, query execution, and compute costs across AWS and Snowflake, keeping data assets performant, secure, and cost-effective.

  • Automation & CI/CD: Implement automated testing and deployment workflows for data pipelines using GitHub Actions and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).

  • Cross-Functional Data Enablement: Partner directly with Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, and domain experts to deliver documented, research-grade, and production-ready datasets.

Qualifications

Core Requirements (Must-Haves)

  • Data Ingestion & Pipeline Orchestration: Advanced Python and analytical SQL for complex data ingestion across diverse file formats, REST APIs, databases, and cloud lakes (S3/Iceberg). Hands-on experience with modern orchestrators (Prefect, Airflow, or Dagster).

  • Entity Resolution & Data Governance: Practical experience with entity resolution/record linkage frameworks (e.g., Splink, dedupe, recordlinkage) and schema management/data contracts (Pydantic, dbt contracts, or JSON Schema).

  • Cloud Platform & Warehouse Infrastructure: Deep hands-on experience in an AWS production environment (S3, ECS/EC2) combined with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake).

  • Automated CI/CD & Workflow Automation: Proven track record of automating data pipeline deployments, integration tests, and validation workflows via GitHub Actions.

Nice-to-Haves (What Will Make You Stand Out)

  • Knowledge Graphs & Healthcare Terminologies: Exposure to ontology/semantic frameworks (RDF/OWL, SKOS, Neo4j, LinkML) or international medical classifications/vocabularies (SNOMED CT, ICD/OPS, FHIR).

Your Profile

Help Us Change the Way the World Works

 

Turn AI ambition into production systems that run the business

Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises.

 

About the Role

Most enterprises have bought AI. Far fewer have it running their core operations. As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Langdock, you take our most valuable customer use cases from idea to production. You work inside the customer's problem, build the agents, workflows, apps and integrations that solve it, and turn every win into a reusable pattern the whole company can use.

You work as part of Customer Success alongside our Account Owner, and you are the technical partner in the customer's transformation. You will feed what you learn in the field back into our product, and you will have real influence over what we build next.

And you will build with our own platform every day. Everyone at Langdock automates their own work with agents and workflows. You will too.

 

What You Will Do

  • Run technical discovery on qualified, high-value use cases: map processes, systems, data flows and constraints with both business and technical stakeholders.

  • Design and build production-grade agents, workflows, Skills, Apps and integrations on Langdock, from first prototype to company-wide rollout.

  • Own the implementation of advanced and beta-feature use cases, and of high-profile proofs of concept, together with the Account Owner.

  • Turn individual solutions you built into reusable patterns, templates and on-platform resources, and maintain the bundles repository.

  • Measure impact: time saved, costs reduced, tools replaced, quality improved and time to value. Package the results into ROI stories that customers and colleagues can act on.

  • Support our Partners with architecture reviews, high-profile scoping sessions and targeted enablement, so they can deliver independently.

  • Be the technical voice of the customer internally, without losing sight of our principle: Product > Customer Success > Marketing > Sales.

 

You Might Be a Fit If…

  • You have 3+ years of experience building production software, data or integration systems, ideally in a customer-facing role.

  • You build with AI, not just talk about it. You have hands-on experience with LLM APIs, agents, tool use, retrieval and workflow automation, and you know how to choose between models and approaches.

  • You can talk credibly about data privacy, security, identity and integration architecture with CISOs, IT leads and engineers, because you have solved these problems before.

  • You are good at scoping. You know which work is worth doing, you say no to the rest, and you ship what you commit to.

  • You translate business problems into technical designs and technical trade-offs into business terms for executives.

  • You are commercially aware. You understand that your work drives retention and expansion, and you care about that outcome.

  • You are fluent in German (C1+) and English.

  • You are a kind person who cares about the people around you.

Bonus: you come from an AI-native company or an early-stage startup. Founder or early-employee experience is a plus, as are public projects such as MCP servers, open-source contributions or AI tooling you have shipped.

 

The Environment

We work from our office in Berlin, Greifswalder Strasse 212. Everyone works together in person because the hardest problems get solved faster at a whiteboard than in a Slack thread. Days start at 8:30. Lunch and dinner are together. We run, go to the gym, and take care of ourselves. Health is not separate from work here, it is part of how we work well.

The vibe is calm but intense. No one is yelling or panicking. But everyone is working hard on things that matter.

 

Compensation

Salaries are transparent and tied to levels, not negotiation. All roles include equity. We will figure out the right level together based on your experience and scope. Levels are about the work you own, not your title or years of experience. We narrow down the expected salary range early in the process.

 

Next steps

We move fast. Most processes complete within two weeks.

If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you.

Work on classification, retrieval, ranking, personalization and evaluation, taking ownership from model development to production deployment.

This role is for engineers who enjoy solving practical ML problems, improving model quality and shipping reliable systems used by real users.

Ideal Experience

  • Training, inference and data pipelines are robust, reproducible and maintainable.

  • Model improvements are driven by real-world feedback and measurable results.

  • Collaborates effectively with engineering and product teams to deliver reliable ML-powered features.

 

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, world-class teams. We are a high-talent-density, hands-on team. We make decisions collectively and move quickly, balancing high-quality work with continuous learning.

Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment and execute independently. Our goal is to put a truly magical product into the hands of our users.

At Flix, we offer a tech-driven environment where innovation meets real-world impact, with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a culture of collaboration and ownership.  

As a Senior Product Owner (m/f/d) in Supply division you will make an impact by owning the problem space of supporting operational staff in the field, driving the full product lifecycle from discovery to outcome measurement, working in close partnership with a global landscape of stakeholders, and shaping the next generation of our products. 

At the centre of this problem space is an app supporting bus drivers, train attendants and station staff in their daily operations around the world. This Android application does not only provide key workflows to its users, but also allows Flix to better understand operational compliance in the field so we can guarantee the best possible passenger experience.  

We're currently building the next generation of this app, making this an exciting moment to join and shape its long-term direction. 

Your engineering counterparts are an Engineering Manager, three Backend engineers, two Mobile engineers and one Data Analyst. Your focus will be on strategy, discovery, and outcomes, while the engineering team owns delivery and ceremonies. 

If you're excited about working on a constantly evolving product used by thousands of operational staff around the world, send us your application! 

About the Role

  • Own the product lifecycle end-to-end: from identifying opportunities and running discovery, through shaping solutions and defining requirements, to measuring outcomes and closing the loop 
  • Co-own your problem space with business counterparts, building a joint partnership that replaces handover-based collaboration with shared accountability for outcomes 
  • Define product strategy and priorities for the app, working across teams and problem spaces rather than being bounded by a single team's scope 
  • Drive hypothesis-driven discovery and outcome measurement, defining success metrics before solution work begins and using them to make explicit continue, pivot, or stop decisions 
  • Partner closely with engineering on priorities, requirements, and release, trusting the EM and team to own delivery and ceremonies 
  • Collaborate with peer Product Owners to align on dependencies and deliver outcomes that span individual team boundaries

About You

  • Proven ability to build strong working relationships with business stakeholders and drive joint decision-making without relying on formal authority
  • Experience owning product problems that cut across team boundaries, keeping multiple stakeholders aligned on direction and trade-offs
  • You're energised by strategy, discovery, and outcomes; you understand that delivery coordination sits with the engineering team
  • Strong analytical foundation; you can connect user research, usability signals, and business metrics to make confident product decisions

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family.

We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision‑making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose.

About the role:

You will engineer the systems required to train foundation models at scale. Your objective is to maximize hardware utilization and training throughput on our large-scale GPU clusters (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs). You will work at the intersection of deep learning frameworks, distributed systems, and GPU microarchitecture, eliminating bottlenecks from the Python layer down to the GPU kernel.

This role is for Aleph Alpha Research GmbH.

Your responsibilities:

  • End-to-End Optimization: Profile training loops using PyTorch Profiler, Nsight Systems and Nsight Compute to identify system- and kernel-level bottlenecks in order to maximize model throughput.

  • Distributed Strategy and Topology: Configure and tune composite parallelism strategies (e.g. TP, DP, HSDP/FSDP, EP), optimizing load balance, minimizing critical-path bottlenecks, and managing communication-to-computation trade-offs for large-scale LLM training.

  • Hardware-Aware Modeling: Partner with AI Researchers to define model architectures for hardware efficiency without compromising convergence.

Your Profile

Basic Qualifications

  • Are proficient in Python and the PyTorch library.

  • Have a strong engineering background in parallel and/or distributed systems with proven track record of excellence.

  • Have hands-on experience with modern machine learning techniques (especially large language models and their life cycle).

  • Deeply understand the CUDA programming model.

  • Have experience in distributed programming with APIs like NCCL or MPI.

  • Have experience analysing profiling traces with tools such as PyTorch Profiler and Nvidia Nsight.

  • Please note this role requires regular on-site collaboration in Heidelberg as a member of the Training Efficiency Team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Contributions to modern distributed training frameworks (e.g., TorchTitan, Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed).

  • Familiarity with low-precision training formats (MXFP4, MXFP8) and their impact on numerical stability and throughput.

  • A deep understanding of NCCL communication primitives, NVSHMEM or CUDA IPC and their performance.

  • A proven track record of implementing and optimising modern transformer-based model training.

  • A proven track record working on the NVIDIA Blackwell architecture.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Forecasting. Run the forecast process end to end with our VP Sales and team leads: weekly hygiene, submit and roll-up, quarterly commit. Diagnose why deals slip, and stand the process up in the US, France and UK as those teams ramp.

  • Insights the company acts on. Define the sales metrics we run on, then turn pipeline and funnel data into the analysis that steers board meetings, monthly GTM reviews and weekly deal inspection. You define what gets measured; our data and BI team build the layer underneath.

  • Commercial process. Design how non-standard deals are managed at voize. You set the rules and stand the function up; you will not be the approval queue.

  • Process and tool enablement. In close collaboration with sales enablement, you make sure what gets built actually gets adopted, partnering with leaders, AEs and SDRs to prioritize the work with the most impact.

  • The GTM stack, built AI-first. Own the sales side of CRM and the tools around it. Automate the manual layer with Claude, n8n and whatever else earns its place, and take a real position on which tooling we buy next as we scale.

🤝 Your Skillset - What you bring to the table

  • 3+ years in revenue operations, sales operations or GTM strategy, at a fast-growing B2B SaaS company or in strategy/tech consulting, VC or M&A before an operating role. You have seen what breaks as a sales team scales, because you were the one who fixed it.

  • Exceptional stakeholder skills. You partner with VPs and team leads as an equal, push back with evidence, and get change adopted by people who do not report to you.

  • Sharp analytical instincts and deep CRM fluency. Expert in spreadsheets, comfortable reading data in a BI tool, and you have owned a HubSpot or Salesforce instance rather than just worked in one. You go deep on data enrichment and spot the patterns that keep our data model trustworthy.

  • You have supported forecasting. You can talk methodology, where it broke, and what you changed. Same for a territory or quota plan you built and aligned with sales leadership.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset and hands-on. You are comfortable with no playbook, you prioritize ruthlessly, and you ship rather than produce recommendations.

Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What We Do

At Mapbox, Technical Program Managers (TPMs) ensure successful, on-time launches for Mapbox's key customers by turning complex needs into realized value. TPMs independently develop and execute strategies to maximize customer satisfaction, while minimizing thrash in changes to priorities and roadmap. They provide high-judgement updates to Mapbox leaders–keeping them informed on progress while handling the day-to-day operations independently.

 

What You'll Do

Mapbox is seeking a Technical Program Manager III (TPM) to lead complex, high-visibility post-sales programs for our large automotive customers. This is a high-impact role in a dynamic environment where you will work both independently and collaboratively alongside a high-performing team of TPMs to deliver successful customer launches. You will drive operational rigor within your programs, acting as a key driver of accountability and consistent, high-quality delivery across cross-functional teams within Mapbox.

In this role you will:

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of complex automotive customer launches and programs, serving as the main point of contact for program health, timelines, and execution

  • Be the primary interface between our key automotive customers and our internal teams, advocating for mutual success by championing the needs of our customers with internal teams (including leadership, product management, engineering, sales, technical support), and representing Mapbox to our customers

  • Define success for our customer programs, including how we measure it, and how we get there.

  • Align with Product and Engineering to translate and prioritize customer feedback into actionable insights and roadmap clarity.

  • Set and uphold a high quality bar, working with technical support, product and engineering teams to ensure effective prioritization and resolution of quality issues, and to synthesize and address overarching quality concerns.

  • Lead senior-level discussions - both internally and externally - around delivery timelines, trade-offs, scope, and business impact.

  • Provide calm and decisive program leadership during high-pressure situations with customers.

  • Provide clear & concise reporting to program key stakeholders and track and manage and report on program risks, working with customers and internal teams to mitigate and/or and escalate for resolution.

  • Lead or contribute to internal initiatives to improve internal processes across the TPM and Mapbox organizations.

  • Develop a deep knowledge of Mapbox products and services in order to steer technical discussions and build trust with our customers

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • 8+ years of experience leading enterprise software implementations in a highly regulated post-sales or professional services environment.

  • Demonstrated success in the automotive industry managing scope, SOW execution, change management, and high-impact customer escalations.

  • Proven ownership of complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deployments from kickoff through production launch.

  • Delivery-Oriented Leader: You are accountable for outcomes and not just coordination. You build structure in ambiguity and create operational discipline that enables predictable success.

  • Customer-Centric Operator: You proactively represent the customer internally and ensure their business objectives drive implementation priorities.

  • Effective Communicator: You engage effectively across audiences from developers to senior executives with clarity, confidence, and precision.

  • Weekly Hours: Full-time

How we support you

data.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

 

As Staff AI Deployment Strategist, you will shape how some of the most ambitious enterprises in the DACH region adopt frontier AI at scale.

This is a senior, high-impact role at the intersection of strategy, technology, and execution. You will work directly on Mistral’s most strategic opportunities and largest deliveries, helping customers move from ambition to measurable business outcomes. You will frame complex AI transformation programs, turn executive priorities into actionable roadmaps, and ensure that Mistral delivers systems that are valuable, scalable, and trusted.

You will also act as a senior sponsor on our most critical customer programs, bringing judgment, structure, and delivery excellence to high-stakes engagements. Your mandate is to raise the ambition and quality of AI adoption: helping customers identify where AI can create step-change value, making the right trade-offs, and ensuring that execution matches the strategic promise.

This role is ideal for an experienced strategy consultant, transformation leader, or senior operator who wants to move from advising on change to building it directly with frontier AI technology.

 

What You Will Do

 

  • Shape high-impact AI transformations

    • Partner closely with Mistral’s Sales leadership in DACH to qualify opportunities, align on account strategy, and drive executive engagement.

    • Work with senior customer stakeholders to identify where frontier AI can create material business value.

    • Structure complex opportunities into clear, credible, and executable transformation programs.

    • Translate strategic ambition into delivery roadmaps, success metrics, and operating plans.

    • Help customers make the right trade-offs between ambition, feasibility, speed, and long-term scalability.

  • Sponsor Mistral’s most strategic deliveries

    • Act as a senior sponsor on the largest and most complex customer programs, primarily in DACH and potentially cross-region as priorities evolve.

    • Ensure delivery quality, executive alignment, and measurable business impact.

    • Anticipate risks, unblock decisions, and help teams navigate ambiguity in high-stakes environments.

    • Bring senior judgment to moments where scope, resources, timelines, or expected value need to be clarified.

  • Build repeatable deployment excellence

    • Turn lessons from strategic engagements into reusable approaches, playbooks, and patterns.

    • Raise the bar for how AI programs are qualified, framed, delivered, and scaled.

    • Act as a senior relay for the Solutions organization in the region, helping teams adopt shared best practices, adapt them thoughtfully to local market specificities when needed, and strengthen the quality of execution.

    • Work hand in hand with Solutions leadership to connect customer realities, delivery patterns, and field feedback into practical ways of improving how Mistral deploys AI.

    • Help codify what great enterprise AI deployment looks like across industries and use cases.

    • Contribute to a Solutions culture that combines strategic clarity, technical depth, and strong execution.

  • Develop and multiply senior DS impact

    • Coach Deployment Strategists on strategic problem-solving, executive communication, and delivery leadership.

    • Help teams raise the quality of their work on the highest-impact opportunities.

    • Identify capability gaps and contribute to hiring, staffing, and development priorities.

    • Act as a force multiplier across accounts, teams, and regions where your experience can have the highest leverage.

 
 

What We're Looking For

 

You are a senior, highly capable professional with strong executive presence, excellent business judgment, and a track record of leading complex strategic or transformation work.

Typical indicators we’re looking for include:

  • 8 to 10+ years of professional experience in strategy consulting, digital transformation, AI, enterprise technology, or a similarly demanding environment.

  • Experience operating at Partner, Principal, Engagement Manager, Director, or equivalent level in a top-tier strategy consulting or transformation context.

  • A strong ability to structure ambiguous problems, identify value, and turn strategy into execution.

  • Experience leading large accounts, complex programs, or senior customer relationships.

  • The credibility to engage with executives and C-level stakeholders on business priorities, trade-offs, and impact.

  • Strong analytical and commercial judgment, with the ability to challenge assumptions constructively.

  • Comfort working at the frontier of technology, even when solutions are evolving quickly and the path is not fully defined.

  • A low-ego, high-ownership mindset and a desire to build with customers and teams, not just advise from a distance.

  • Fluency in English; German is a strong plus.

 

We are looking for adaptable, low-ego team players who are passionate about turning AI vision into reality and delivering transformative impact for our customers.

 

Hiring Process

 

• Talent Acquisition screening call

• 30min Hiring Manager Interview

• 45min Business Acumen Interview 

• 60min Technical Deep Dive on LLMs

• Panel (Home Prep & Restitution)

• 30min Value Talk

• Reference check

 

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

data.description:
Über LIFTED

LIFTED is a strength training company from Berlin. We run six studios across the city and plan to have 20 by the end of 2027, with Munich, Hamburg, Cologne and Düsseldorf next. Our goal is to become the largest fitness company in Europe. Before LIFTED, the founding team helped build and scale BEAT81. Today we’re profitable and owner-led.

Why this role exists
Today Carl, one of the founders, runs finance alongside managing the company, with bookkeeping at an external tax firm. You take this over and build the finance team.


Your role
You report to Carl, sit in the management meeting and approve spending within budget.


What you own

  • Finance ops. You lead our finance trainee, who handles receipts, invoices and account coding based on clear rules. You review samples, resolve new cases and adapt the rules. You also manage payments, payroll and the month-end and year-end close with our tax firm.

  • Planning and liquidity. You own our planning model, plan liquidity monthly, and run the annual and three-year budget, forecasts and scenarios. Before we sign a new location, you build its business case and add it to the planning model.

  • Reporting. You set up monthly management reporting that we use in the management meeting.

  • Financing. You prepare our financing and, over time, lead parts of the conversations with our financing partners.

  • HR admin. You handle employee data and contracts. Right now that’s a few hours a month.

  • Team. You build the finance team and help us decide when HR needs its own role.

How we measure success

  • After 3 months, you’ve taken over finance from Carl, from daily operations and HR admin to planning and liquidity.

  • After 6 months, management reporting runs every month. You’ve built the business cases for the locations we signed in that time and prepared your first financing.

  • After 12 months, you run the annual and three-year budget, align it with the team leads and review it with us every quarter. You prepare our financing end to end and lead parts of the conversations with our financing partners yourself.


What you bring
You might have done most of this before, or you’re ready to grow into it.

  • Around 4–6 years in finance, including experience at a startup or scale-up

  • A strong academic background in business, finance or a similar field

  • Experience with month-end closes and working with an external tax firm

  • Experience building or fundamentally rebuilding a planning model in spreadsheets

  • Sound understanding of account coding

  • You want to understand how a studio makes money and use the numbers to shape decisions with us

  • Fluent German, English C1

  • You live in Berlin or are moving here, and work with us in the office

Nice to have:

  • Experience in a fast-growing business with multiple locations

  • Experience preparing financing, for example bank or development loans

  • Experience with SKR03, DATEV, Moss, Helu or similar tools

  • First leadership experience

What we offer

  • The chance to build our finance team

  • You work directly with Carl, who coaches you on the business side, from location decisions to financing

  • A spacious and bright office at Senefelder Platz, between Mitte and Prenzlauer Berg

  • Free, unlimited membership at all LIFTED studios

  • Team events like padel and BBQs

How to apply
No cover letter needed. Send us your CV with a short note (3–5 sentences) about something in finance you built or changed yourself: What was the problem, what did you do, and what changed afterwards?

Start
As soon as possible

data.description:
JOIN US

Bei Code Gaia zu arbeiten bedeutet, dass du an etwas sehr Wichtigem arbeitest: Der Transformation zu einer nachhaltigen Wirtschaft. Wir sind dafür da, dass Nachhaltigkeit nicht mühsam oder zeitaufwendig für Unternehmen ist. Stattdessen wollen wir kleine und mittelständische Unternehmen ermutigen, gemeinsam gegen den Klimawandel und soziale Ungerechtigkeit vorzugehen. Unser Ziel ist es, eine praktische Lösung anzubieten und Unternehmen dabei zu helfen, die Arbeitsabläufe im Nachhaltigkeitsmanagement und -reporting zu automatisieren und gleichzeitig für sie einen wirtschaftlichen Mehrwert zu schaffen. Aufgrund unserer steigenden Kundenzahlen, sowie der bevorstehenden Gesetzgebung brauchen wir Verstärkung im Team und würden dich gerne dabei haben. Auf dich wartet eine spannende Reise zur führenden Sustainability Plattform für SMEs in Europa und du kannst mit dabei sein.

WHAT YOU DO

  • Die Rolle ist "post-sales" und als solche innerhalb des technischen Nachhaltigkeitsteams unseres Unternehmens angesiedelt
  • Etwa 70-80 % der Aufgaben konzentrieren sich auf Kundenbetreuung und Kundenmanagement, während die verbleibenden Aufgaben die Auswertung individueller Kundendaten und die Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen umfassen
  • Du wirst ermutigt und unterstützt, dein eigenes technisches Fachwissen im Bereich der Nachhaltigkeit aufzubauen, um auch Projektinhalte für Kunden zu liefern
  • Du onboardest neue Kund:innen in unsere Software
  • Du unterstützt Kund:Innen als "Clearingstelle" für Fragen und Probleme im Zusammenhang mit der Nutzung unserer Produkte und führst ihre technische Beratung im Bereich der Nachhaltigkeit durch
  • Du interpretierst die Ergebnisse unserer Software (Nachhaltigkeits-KPIs und Inhalte) für Kund:Innen und unterstützt sie bei Entscheidungen zur optimalen Nutzung unserer Tools und Dienstleistungen
  • Du bist die interne Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Vertriebsteams, der Nachhaltigkeitsfunktion und unseren Softwareingenieuren
  • Du entwickelst und verwaltest die Tools zur Überwachung von Kundenaktivitäten und reagierst auf diese Überwachung
  • Die primäre interne Arbeitssprache wird Englisch sein, aber die Kommunikation mit den Kund:Innen erfolgt hauptsächlich auf Deutsch

WHO YOU ARE

  • Du hast mindestens ein Jahr Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Funktion
  • Du besitzt Arbeitserfahrung mit mindestens einem der folgenden Themen: GHG-Protokoll, GRI, DNK, Ecovadis
  • Du besitzt Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig und kundenorientiert
  • Dich zeichnet eine strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise aus
  • Du kommunizierst klar und souverän
  • Du bist motiviert neue Nachhaltigkeitsinhalte eigenständig zu lernen
  • Erfahrung mit dem GHG Protokoll ist ein Plus
  • Du hast verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse

WHAT TO EXPECT

Hybrid Work & Freedom | Wir glauben fest daran, dass jedes Arbeitsumfeld ideal und auf die jeweilige Person zugeschnitten sein muss. Aus diesem Grund arbeiten unsere Teammitglieder remote oder in unseren Büros in München oder Berlin - auf ihre eigene Art und Weise. So können wir sicherstellen, dass alle unsere Talente viel Freiraum haben, um die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

Ownership & Impact | Bei Code Gaia haben alle unsere Teammitglieder eine Stimme. Wir schätzen jede Meinung und ermutigen alle, ihre Meinung zu sagen. Nur mit Teamarbeit können wir etwas Sinnvolles schaffen. Wir glauben an unser Team und geben ihm daher viel Eigenverantwortung. Selbst wenn wir scheitern, lernen wir daraus, stehen wieder auf und arbeiten weiter am Erfolg. Das ist Teil des Spiels und wir wissen es.

Personal & Professional Growth | Deine Entwicklung ist unsere Priorität. Mit unserem intensiven Onboarding, Feedbackgesprächen und Schulungen fördern wir deine persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung. Einer unserer Kernwerte ist "Keep Growing" (Wachsen), den wir in allem, was wir tun, zum Ausdruck bringen.

Best Equipment, Tech Stack & Processes | Du arbeitest mit bewährten Prozessen, bist aber jederzeit eingeladen, diese zu hinterfragen. Außerdem möchten wir, dass du so produktiv wie möglich bist - sag uns, was du brauchst, um produktiv zu sein.

C ompetitive salary package | Wir bieten ein faires Gehalt. Code Gaia ist auf dem besten Weg, in die Höhe zu schießen, und wir möchten, dass du ein Teil davon bist und an unserer Wachstumsreise teilnimmst.

Team Events | Wir wissen, dass es schwierig sein kann, einen starken Teamgeist aufzubauen, wenn man ausschließlich aus der Ferne arbeitet. Bei Code Gaia legen wir jedoch großen Wert auf die Teambildung und veranstalten das ganze Jahr über verschiedene Teamevents. Wir verstehen die Notwendigkeit der Interaktion von Angesicht zu Angesicht und ermutigen sie stark.

Impact driven & passionate team | Zu guter Letzt sind wir das wirkungsorientierteste Team, das du dir vorstellen kannst. Wir lieben die Zusammenarbeit und leben unsere Unternehmenswerte jeden Tag. Darüberhinaus kompensiert Code Gaia natürlich den eigenen CO2-Fußabdruck.

Is it a Match?

Ja?! Dann sende uns gerne deinen Lebenslauf. Wir freuen uns auf dich!
