data.title: Mechanical Engineer

data.description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the Role

We're looking for a hands-on scientist-engineer to help build our next-generation DNA synthesis platform, enabling high-throughput, cost-effective production of large and diverse DNA libraries. You'll work at the intersection of chemistry, materials science, bioengineering, and hardware development, designing and building prototypes, running experiments, and optimizing processes to turn new synthesis technologies into reliable, scalable production systems.

DNA synthesis is a fundamental part of our protein engineering platform. We're developing new approaches to dramatically increase synthesis throughput while reducing cost and turnaround time.

You'll work closely with our scientific and engineering teams to develop and prototype new DNA synthesis technologies. Your focus will be on translating scientific concepts into working hardware and experimental systems, designing and building prototypes, testing different approaches, and continuously improving their performance.

This is a highly hands-on, interdisciplinary role combining experimental science with practical engineering. You'll take ownership of prototype development, experimental validation, and process optimization, helping move promising technologies from early concepts to reliable, scalable systems.

We're looking for someone who enjoys building things, solving technical problems, and working across disciplines. You don't need to be an expert in DNA synthesis, but you should have strong scientific fundamentals, an engineering mindset, and experience turning ideas into working prototypes.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and test prototypes for next-generation DNA synthesis technologies.

  • Translate scientific and technical requirements into practical engineering designs and experimental setups.

  • Scope and evaluate different technical approaches, components, materials, and equipment for prototype development.

  • Develop and optimize the chemistry, materials, and processes underlying the synthesis platform.

  • Design and execute experiments to characterize performance, identify limitations, and improve reliability.

  • Work closely with mechanical, electronics, software, and automation engineers to develop integrated experimental systems.

  • Troubleshoot complex technical problems across chemistry, hardware, and process engineering.

  • Develop analytical methods and quality control strategies to measure performance and guide optimization.

  • Help scale successful prototypes into robust, reproducible systems suitable for routine production.

  • Work with external suppliers and engineering partners to source components, evaluate technologies, and accelerate development.

What We're Looking For

  • A strong background in chemical engineering, chemistry, materials science, bioengineering, mechanical engineering, or a related field.

  • Hands-on experience designing, building, and testing experimental setups, prototypes, or laboratory equipment.

  • Strong understanding of chemistry, materials, or process engineering, with the ability to apply these fundamentals to practical engineering challenges.

  • Experience developing and optimizing experimental processes, including systematic troubleshooting and performance characterization.

  • Comfortable working across hardware and experimental science, translating scientific requirements into practical engineering solutions.

  • Experience selecting components, evaluating technical trade-offs, and iterating on prototype designs.

  • Strong experimental skills, including designing experiments, analyzing data, and making decisions based on results.

  • Independent, resourceful, and comfortable working on open-ended technical problems.

  • A practical, hands-on approach to engineering, with a focus on building, testing, and improving systems rather than purely theoretical development.

  • Experience with DNA or oligonucleotide synthesis, including chemical or enzymatic approaches, is a plus.

  • Experience with solid-phase synthesis, surface chemistry, or chemical process development is a plus.

  • Familiarity with microfluidics, high-throughput dispensing, or array-based technologies is a plus.

  • Experience with laboratory automation, instrumentation, or custom hardware development is a plus.

  • Experience with CAD, electronics, fluidics, or mechanical prototyping is a plus.

  • Experience scaling experimental technologies from proof of concept to production is a plus.

  • Programming and data analysis experience, particularly in Python, is a plus.

Details

  • Location: Lausanne, Switzerland (on-site)

  • Type: Full time

  • Start date: ASAP

We review applications on a rolling basis.

Application deadline

About the Role

This is not a lab technician position. This is a senior scientist who owns assay quality, data QC and controls, and production troubleshooting across the entire experimental pipeline.

The production team runs 150+ experiments per month across expression, BLI, SPR, thermostability, and enzyme activity. When something goes wrong (failed expression, anomalous binding data, instrument artifacts), this person diagnoses the root cause and fixes it. As the assay and instrumentation portfolio expands, this person translates new R&D methods into production-ready protocols, builds robust methods that junior technicians can execute reliably, and designs comprehensive controls that enable automated QC and data processing.

This is a player-coach position. You will still run experiments personally, especially as you integrate into the lab, but you will also elevate the whole team's capabilities.

What You'll Do

  • Troubleshoot production failures across the full pipeline. A batch of proteins isn't expressing: is it the construct design, the expression system, or the media? BLI sensorgrams look noisy: is it the sensor tips, the sample prep, or an instrument issue? You figure it out, fix it, and make the cause easier to identify next time.

  • Develop and document SOPs for new assays as the portfolio expands. Take methods from the R&D team and make them production-ready: robust, reproducible, and executable by junior technicians without hand-holding.

  • Mentor a growing production team. Set quality standards, review data, train new hires, and build a culture where people flag problems early instead of hiding them.

  • Work at the intersection of biology, automation, and QC. Collaborate with researchers, laboratory technicians, and automation engineers on protocol optimization for work cells, and with software on LabOS protocol integration.

  • Own the relationship between assay science and throughput. The easy version of every assay doesn't scale, and the scalable version often sacrifices quality. You find the right tradeoff.

What We're Looking For

  • Deep hands-on expertise in protein production: expression (E. coli, mammalian, cell-free), purification (IMAC, SEC), and biophysical characterization (BLI and SPR at minimum). This isn't negotiable. You need to have done this work yourself, at volume.

  • PhD in protein biochemistry, biophysics, or structural biology, plus 3-5 years in a production or development role at a CRO, foundry, or high-throughput lab. Academic postdocs count if the work was high-throughput and production-oriented.

  • Experience with high-throughput workflows. You're comfortable with 96-well plates and liquid handlers, not just single-column purifications. You've optimized protocols for scale, not just for one perfect result.

  • Mentorship mindset. You've managed or trained junior scientists before. You enjoy teaching and get satisfaction from watching your team grow.

  • Troubleshooting instinct. When data looks wrong, your first impulse is to understand why, not to rerun the experiment and hope it works.

  • Quality-obsessed but pragmatic. You care deeply about data quality, but you also understand that production has deadlines and sometimes "good enough" is the right call.

  • Bridge between R&D and production. You can speak both languages: the exploratory mindset of research and the reproducibility demands of production.

Monumental is automating on-site construction with robotics and software. Our mission is to make construction software-defined and autonomous - a future where beautiful, bespoke buildings go up in a single day, with minimal labour.

We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from companies like Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta and Google DeepMind. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you’ll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural.

Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with an fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house - hardware and software, we're explicitly not a hybrid or remote-first company - you can't build robots or walls from home, so we're onsite five days a week.

 

Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about our vision and company. You might enjoy Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage, or this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like.

About the role

Monumental are already deploying robots into the real world at scale, building beautiful, bespoke homes. Our robots are on sites across the Netherlands and the UK and will be in the US within a year. Every deployment teaches us something about our hardware; you’ll push our R&D fleet to become one ready for large-series production: you'll own taking us from tens of robots a year to hundreds, and then thousands. You'll also keep that growing fleet deployable, and making design changes yourself to improve reliability and serviceability.

Scaling a fleet means solving whatever is in the way: limited space, no clear production process, lead times we can't live with and modules that don't survive the harsh conditions of a construction site. You’ll be expected to wear many hats; we’re looking for people who are genuinely excited to lead these efforts.

Our robots are built from modules at every level of maturity, so expect to work with the hardware R&D team at early stages of development to validate R&D designs as fast as we can. In parallel, you'll be in the workshop determining how we assemble them: the processes, the fixtures, the production space itself, getting the very best out of our Amsterdam facilities.

For more context on building hardware at Monumental, read Niall’s Substack: I quit my job and moved country to make robots that will fix Europe’s housing crisis.

What you'll do

  • Bottom line, you'll own increasing our quarterly production from 30 sets of robot systems to 100 within a year. This is a challenge. You'll be building the production capabilities at Monumental rather than inheriting them, and you'll do it alongside engineers and technicians who care a great deal about getting this right.

  • Take prototypes through to production-ready modules. Find and address design flaws, validate improvements, and push these modules to production.

  • Assembling modules, understand the friction slowing production, and address issues yourself along with the hardware team.

  • Develop fixtures, jigs and light automation solutions to support module assembly.

  • Find production processes that bring minimal value when done in-house. Work with external suppliers to outsource them, while maintaining production quality.

  • Produce drawings, assembly instructions and quality checks to make sure our modules are integrated together and our robots are brought up with no errors.

What we're looking for

  • Industry experience, ideally in a VC-backed start-up, transitioning products from prototype to production

  • Hands-on, analytical mindset: skilled at building assemblies, running studies, analysing data, solving production and quality issues, and collaborating with technicians to implement and validate improvements

  • Proficiency in mechanical assembly (press fits, fastener selection, harness, etc.)

  • Strong knowledge of GD&T and producing 3D and 2D drawings

  • Experience creating structured process documentation (work instructions, SOPs, quality checklists)

  • Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken

Nice-to-haves

  • BSc in Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing or Industrial Engineering, or equivalent

  • Familiarity with robotics or complex electromechanical systems

  • Experience with ERP tools (Odoo or similar)

Why Monumental?

Joining Monumental means being at the forefront of a movement aimed at making significant strides in the construction industry. Here, your work has the potential to impact not just the company but the future of how we build. If you're driven by innovation, eager to tackle complex challenges, and ready to make a tangible difference, we want to hear from you.

 

For open applications (where you don’t see an exact role match), please reach out to us at: ----- - share with us the most interesting or challenging project you’ve worked on, why you want to join and your CV or portfolio.

 

Unfortunately we do not currently support internships.

 

If you don’t meet all the qualifications here but are excited about Monumental and feel you’d still be able to help us solve difficult problems, do get in touch. We welcome generalists who focus on outcomes and are eager to learn on the job.

Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

The Problem You'll Solve

Prosus is building an AI-first future across a global portfolio that spans food delivery, e-commerce, fintech, and education. We invest over $100 million annually in AI, run 800+ models in production, and have deployed Toqan — our internal platform for building, testing, and deploying GenAI and agentic workflows — across the organisation. The scale of ambition is real; the challenge now is focus, coherence, and velocity.

As Group Product Manager for our AI Platform, you will own the multi-year product strategy for the platform that underpins every AI initiative across Prosus. This means defining and sequencing the roadmap for agent infrastructure, evaluation frameworks, model deployment pipelines, and the shared capabilities that internal teams — from applied science to application engineering — rely on to build and ship AI products. You will balance long-term platform investments against the immediate, high-impact needs of teams across the portfolio who are racing to deliver.

You will lead and mentor a team of product managers, instilling product discipline and building the PM talent pipeline that scales with the platform. You will partner closely with engineering and applied science leadership to shape the technical strategy — making the hard trade-offs between model performance, latency, cost, and reliability that determine what we can promise the business.

And you will be the connective tissue: the person who turns ambiguous, fast-moving business needs into clear requirements, who aligns stakeholders across functions and geographies, and who ensures that what we build is not just technically impressive but adopted, trusted, and measurably impactful.

Who You Are

You are a senior product leader who has lived through the messy reality of building platform products for internal teams — and loved it. You measure your success not by features shipped but by the velocity and quality of the teams who build on top of your platform.

You are deeply technical. You can engage substantively with engineering and applied science teams on model lifecycle, MLOps, evaluation frameworks, and infrastructure trade-offs — not as a bystander, but as a thought partner. You understand agentic architectures, LLM capabilities and limitations, and the operational realities of running AI in production at scale.

You are a people leader. You have managed and mentored product managers, and you take genuine pride in their growth. You set strategic direction, coordinate overlapping roadmaps into a coherent plan, and create the clarity that lets your team operate with autonomy and purpose.

You thrive in ambiguity. You have worked in fast-paced, high-scale environments where priorities shift and the path forward is not always clear. You do not wait for perfect information — you run rapid experiments, test hypotheses, and let data and user feedback guide the next step.

You are a communicator. You can simplify complex technical concepts for executive leadership one hour and dig into detailed requirements with an engineering team the next. You build trust across functions and geographies, and you are as comfortable pushing back as you are building consensus.

You are customer-obsessed — even when your customers are internal teams. You connect frequently with the people who use your platform, validate solutions through product discovery, and treat adoption as a first-class metric.

What You Bring

  • 8+ years in product management, with at least 3–5 years in formal people-management roles leading a team of product managers.

  • Demonstrated success owning platform-level or infrastructure products used by internal teams — ideally including AI/ML platform capabilities, MLOps tooling, or developer-facing services.

  • Hands-on experience with generative AI, LLMs, and the model lifecycle (training, fine-tuning, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring) in production environments.

  • Track record of defining and executing multi-year product strategies in fast-moving, high-scale environments.

Technical Depth

  • Ability to engage substantively with engineering and applied science teams on architectural decisions, infrastructure trade-offs, and AI system design.

  • Familiarity with agentic workflows, agent frameworks, and the operational patterns that make AI agents reliable at scale.

  • Strong data-driven decision-making: comfortable with analytics tooling, A/B testing, defining and tracking KPIs, and using metrics to measure adoption, accuracy, latency, and ROI.

  • Experience with modern product and engineering tooling (e.g., Databricks, Jira, Confluence, Figma) and agile methodologies.

Leadership & Influence

  • Proven ability to mentor and grow product managers, instilling PM best practices and building talent pipelines.

  • Stakeholder management across functions and geographies — aligning engineering, applied science, business teams, and executive leadership around a shared roadmap.

  • A bias toward ownership: you take accountability for outcomes, protect your engineers' focus, and course-correct execution without waiting to be asked.

Mindset

  • Customer-first: you translate needs into technical requirements, push back when scope dilutes value, and advocate relentlessly for the people who use your platform.

  • Comfort with ambiguity: you structure complex problems, propose pilots to validate direction, and create clarity for new and evolving teams.

  • AI intuition: you stay current on models, frameworks, and evaluation methods — not as a researcher, but with the hands-on curiosity of a builder.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

About us:

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

About the role:

Restaurant owners generally aren't on LinkedIn and they don't read e-books. They ask friends, search Google, and more and more often, they ask ChatGPT. We need someone who can find new ways to reach them and get those ideas live quickly.

We're hiring a Growth Marketer to build and ship our organic and non-paid growth experiments. This role is for a builder, not a strategist. You'd rather ship a working test today than a polished deck next week. You'll take ideas from the backlog to live, measure them honestly, and double down on what works. Using AI and no-code tools, you'll build pages, tools and campaigns yourself instead of relying on agencies and six-figure budgets.

You'll report to the Head of Marketing, who sets direction and priorities. You'll work in deep collaboration with our other growth marketers, product marketing and creative teammates, plus embed yourself in the wider org of Sales, Account Management, RevOps, Product, and more.

What you'll be doing:

  • Ship growth experiments, fast: Take ideas from our growth backlog and get them live: landing pages, tools, ads and content. Run plenty of them, keep what works and kill what doesn't.

  • Get Tebi recommended by AI: Own our visibility in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and Google's AI Overviews. Create and update content built to be cited, not just published, and track how often we show up compared with competitors.

  • Build tools operators actually use: Build free tools, calculators and templates for restaurant owners, and scale our programmatic landing pages. Use no-code, AI and vibe coding tools to ship without waiting on engineering.

  • Run creative campaigns: Help launch scrappy, unconventional campaigns across markets, from competitive campaigns to guerrilla and partner media, with the support of our Marketing team.

  • Turn word of mouth into a channel: Test referral and sharing ideas that turn merchant word of mouth into a steady flow of demo requests. Work with our Product Growth team to build the winners into the product.

  • Keep paid and organic working together: Support our performance agency with landing pages, creative tests and tracking.

  • Measure everything: Keep the experiment log up to date: hypothesis, cost, result and next step. Set up tracking and UTMs properly so we know what actually drove each demo.

How we'll measure success:

  • Experiments shipped each month, and what we learned from them

  • Demo requests from organic and other non-paid channels

  • How often Tebi appears in AI answers for our category, by market

  • Demos from free tools, the reservation widget and programmatic pages

What you’ll bring:

  • Think like a growth marketer but move like a hacker. You know what drives results and how to build just enough to prove it

  • Ship rather than spec. A working prototype today beats a polished plan next week

  • Have built and launched things yourself, like pages, tools, automations or campaigns, and can tell us what happened, including what didn't work

  • Already use AI to work faster and have a point of view on how it's changing the way people find products

  • Are hands-on with no-code and AI tools (Framer or Webflow, Zapier or Make, Claude or ChatGPT, Cursor or similar), without being precious about the stack

  • Are comfortable with data and honest about results, in GA4, HubSpot, Looker or whatever gets the answer

  • Have creative, sharp ideas and the discipline to ship the unglamorous parts too

  • Take ownership and don't wait to be told what to do. No task is above or beneath you

  • Speak fluent English. Another European language is a plus

Nice to have:

  • Experience with SEO, and with AEO or getting a brand cited by AI tools

  • Experience marketing to small businesses, or a background in hospitality

  • Vibe-coding projects you're proud of

We don't have a minimum number of years for this role. We care more about how you think and what you've built than how long you've been doing it. If this sounds like you but you don't tick every box, we'd still like to hear from you.

Benefits:

  • Start-up Equity

  • Competitive Salary

  • Lunch Provided in Office

  • Team building events

  • Unlimited time off

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

People Business Partner & Total Rewards

Most People roles ask you to run processes someone else built. This one asks you to build them, and to own one of them outright: how Eye rewards and recognises its people. You’ll do that while partnering the part of the business where cybersecurity actually happens, with managers who are still learning to lead and specialists who know exactly how rare they are. If you need a mature organization around you to do your best work, this isn’t it. If you get energy from building one, keep reading.

The role

This role has two halves, and you’ll split your time roughly evenly between them.

The first half is Total Rewards. You’ll own compensation and benefits at Eye, including salary reviews, benchmarking, levelling, benefits and our equity program. There’s no finished framework waiting for you. You’ll shape it, make it hold up as we grow, and get us ready for EU pay transparency. You don’t need to be a reward specialist yet. If you owned reward projects before and want to make this your expertise, this is where you do it.

The second half is partnering. You’ll be the People Business Partner for our core business: security operations, incident response, customer support & onboarding, and project management. It’s the most varied population in the company: working students running shift rosters next to deeply specialized senior engineers, and managers at very different stages of their leadership journey.

That mix is exactly why this role needs presence more than years. You’ll coach a first-time manager on the basics one hour and align a salary band with C-level the next. You’ll need to be comfortable doing both, and to enjoy it.

What you’ll do

  • Own Total Rewards end to end: run the annual salary review, keep our benchmarks honest, and build levelling and salary bands that make sense to managers and employees alike.

  • Manage benefits: run our benefits across the Netherlands, the UK, Germany and Belgium, work with providers, and keep improving what actually matters to our people.

  • Manage our equity program: grants, refreshers, and making sure people understand what their equity means.

  • Prepare Eye for pay transparency: work with Legal and Finance so we’re ready for the EU directive, not scrambling to catch up.

  • Be the trusted partner for leaders in security operations and customer support: coaching, challenging and advising at every level of maturity, up to and including the executive team.

  • Be visible. This is an office where face-to-face matters: you’ll be on the floor in The Hague, listening to what’s actually going on, not partnering from a distance.

  • Handle the real side of employee relations: sick leave and reintegration, conduct issues and complex cases, working with external counsel when needed. You’ve seen the challenging cases and you don’t flinch.

What we’re looking for

  • HRBP experience in a scaling tech environment. You know what good looks like at 200+ people.

  • Strong stakeholder management and the presence to challenge back, including senior leadership, without becoming the policy police.

  • Genuinely comfortable with ambiguity. Our problems don’t come with a manual, and you’d rather solve them creatively than wait for one.

Your Role

We are looking for a Trust & Safety Product Manager to own the product and technical delivery of our compliance and safety initiatives across our platforms.

You will turn safety requirements into effective product features, moderation capabilities, third-party integrations, and measurable improvements. Working closely with Compliance, Engineering, AI/ML, Product, and Customer Support, you will help us identify risks earlier, build safeguards into new features, and continuously improve how our safety systems perform.

This is a newly created role within our Product team, working directly with our CTO, Michael Monin and our Legal & Safety Lead, Maxwelle Sokol. You will have significant ownership from the outset and the opportunity to shape how the safety product function develops as the company continues to grow.

Our platform serves adults and permits lawful adult content. We are looking for someone who can navigate sensitive, context-dependent issues thoughtfully, protecting users and enforcing clear boundaries without unnecessarily restricting legitimate expression.

Here’s what you can expect:

Key Responsibilities

  • Safety & legal product strategy and delivery. Translate safety policies, legal requirements (e.g., in online safety and AI-specific laws such as the EU AI Act), incident findings, and user feedback into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria, and engineering work. Drive initiatives from problem definition through implementation, testing, launch, and ongoing improvement.

  • Internally developed moderation technologies. Own the product side of improvements to our in-house moderation systems, including our proprietary LLM technology EverGuard. Partner with Engineering and AI/ML teams on, e.g., detection capabilities, moderation rules and thresholds, and appropriate interventions across user inputs and AI-generated outputs.

  • Third-party safety partnerships and integrations. Lead the technical and product lifecycle of third-party safety partnerships, from identifying needs and evaluating providers to implementation, testing, rollout, and ongoing performance management.

  • Safety dashboards, monitoring, and quality assurance. Establish dashboards and a recurring QA that help us proactively identify emerging issues, prevent harmful content, and ensure that our T&S measures are working as intended.

  • Red teaming and adversarial testing. Own our testing for how moderation systems and product safeguards respond to deliberate misuse and difficult edge cases. Track findings through remediation, retesting, and closure—not just delivery of a report.

  • Trust and safety reviews for new features. Establish and run a dedicated T&S review for new features, with proportionate reviews for material changes to existing features, models, and integrations. Engage early in product design to identify foreseeable misuse, affected users, and appropriate safeguards.

  • Incident follow-through and continuous improvement. Coordinate the product and engineering response to significant safety issues, working with colleagues responsible for incident management, policy, and user support.

Learn more about our Trust & Safety infrastructure in our Trust & Safety Hub.

Your Qualifications

  • Data-driven product decisions that align with legal/ethical standards: You can name the metrics you want to influence, explain why it matters, and say whether your work actually moved them. You’ve run A/B tests, product experiments, data deep-dives, or lightweight user research and used the findings to shape what was built next. You can assess risks associated with user-generated content, transactions, and interactions, and translate these into policies that align with legal and ethical standards, trackers/dashboards, and strategic planning;

  • Content moderation and AI guardrails: You understand how product realities and safety requirements interact on a tech platform; you explore strategies for efficient and scalable content moderation, including automation, machine learning, human review and user reporting.

  • Legal/safety work experience: You have worked closely with trust and safety and compliance requirements and understand how to translate and implement these for a consumer-facing product;

  • Collaborative mindset and communication: You work cross-functionally with engineering, legal, operations, and customer support teams — these are your partners and support system, not your adversaries or a box to be checked. You ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and are fully fluent and comfortable in English;

  • AI fluency: You are completely comfortable working with and leveraging AI tools. You actively seek out and experiment with new tools and techniques without waiting for a project or manager to require them;

  • You are point person for third-party partnerships: You proactively test and can autonomously handle discussions with third-party tools and integrations that affect our compliance and safety posture;

  • You take ownership and move without waiting for certainty: Comfortable with ambiguity, you create clarity by investigating, building, testing, and learning rather than waiting for a complete brief. You balance execution against planning, address blockers early, and take responsibility for the outcome rather than waiting to be told what to do, caring more about reaching the right result than following a fixed process;

  • You are comfortable with the product category: you are fully comfortable building products based on uncensored models and content;

Bonus points

  • You have previous legal/compliance education

  • Professional experience or interest in AI

  • Experience with consumer-facing features, particularly in the entertainment or gaming industry

Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English)

🎯 Goal-oriented, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and need people who can balance execution, planning, and strategy

We believe strongly that information can be learned, but effort and motivation cannot. If this role appeals to you but you don’t have hands-on experience in all the fields listed in this job description, apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a good fit!

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

ABOUT THE BRAND
 
At Karl Lagerfeld, we are driven by Karl’s mantra: “Embrace the present and invent the future.”
 
Always contemporary and forward-looking, the House of KARL LAGERFELD shares the creative vision and design aesthetic of its iconic founder, Karl Lagerfeld.
 
We are the only fashion house that carries Karl’s name on its door and we strive to live up to this responsibility in everything we do, every day, with the utmost joy and passion.
 
Our headquarters in Paris and in Amsterdam are home to a highly diverse and driven team of KARL family members that hail from over 35 countries. Together, we aim to create meaningful stories and product concepts that connect to Karl’s world and iconic attributes.
 
Women’s & Men's ready-to-wear, bags, small leather goods, swimwear and underwear are managed directly from our Amsterdam headquarters, while other categories, including footwear, fragrances, eyewear and more, are developed with best-in-class licensing partners.
 
We connect with our consumers on multiple levels, ensuring that our online and offline approach goes hand in hand. We thrive to maximize consumer engagement via more than 200 KL stores worldwide, our premium wholesale partners, and our strong digital footprint, spearheaded by our  karllagerfeld.com and 35 countries. Our digital channels currently represent more than 30% of our overall full-price business.
 
We are a dynamic, fast-growing and inclusive company built on professionalism and strong values. At KARL LAGERFELD we’re committed to working toward the highest standards of sustainability and integrity across all areas of our business,. In 2019, KARL LAGERFELD joined as a founding member of the Fashion Pact, a global sustainability initiative seeking to transform the fashion industry through objectives in three areas: climate, biodiversity and ocean protection.

THE ROLE

Are you looking to join a dynamic, fast-growing international fashion and retail company? We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Senior Accounts Payable Coordinator to support our Finance team. 

This role is responsible for managing the end-to-end accounts payable process, ensuring timely and accurate invoice processing, payment execution, vendor management, and compliance with internal controls.

The ideal candidate has experience working with Finance ERP, Medius AP Automation, and possesses a solid understanding of the Purchase Order (PO) lifecycle within a retail environment. You will thrive in a fast-paced international setting, demonstrate strong organizational skills, and maintain a high level of accuracy and professionalism.

Reporting directly to the Accounts Payable Team Lead, you will play a key role in supporting the financial operations of the business.

 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Invoice Processing & Vendor Management

• Process supplier invoices accurately and efficiently through Medius and M3, ensuring compliance with company policies and procedures.
• Perform thorough validation of invoice documentation and coding, allocating costs to the correct financial dimensions, entities, and cost center.
• Monitor and manage invoice workflows, ensuring timely approvals and resolution of exceptions.
• Maintain vendor master data, including the creation, modification, and validation of supplier records.
• Develop and maintain strong relationships with external vendors and internal stakeholders.

Purchase Order Management

• Review and validate invoices against approved Purchase Orders and Goods Receipts.
• Investigate and resolve PO-related discrepancies, including price variances, quantity mismatches, and missing receipts.
• Work closely with Procurement, Retail Operations, and business stakeholders to ensure adherence to the Purchase-to-Pay (P2P) process.
• Support continuous improvement of PO compliance and invoice automation processes.

Payments & Cash Management

• Prepare and process weekly payment runs, including both batch and manual payments, ensuring adherence to agreed payment terms.
• Respond promptly to supplier inquiries regarding payment status and account reconciliations.
• Record and reconcile bank transactions accurately within the accounting system.

Reconciliations & Controls

• Perform regular supplier statement reconciliations and proactively resolve discrepancies.
• Monitor AP aging balances and follow up on outstanding items to ensure timely resolution.
• Support month-end and year-end closing activities related to accounts payable.
• Ensure compliance with internal controls, financial policies, and audit requirements.
• Assist with internal and external audits by providing supporting documentation and responding to audit requests.

Team & Administrative Support

• Manage shared Accounts Payable mailboxes, ensuring effective communication and timely handling of requests.
• Process employee expense claims in accordance with company policies and approval procedures.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of Accounts Payable processes and finance operations.
• Support day-to-day Finance department activities as required.

THE PROFILE:

Experience & Knowledge

data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Executive DACH (Swiss German-speaking) / (German + French-speaking) based in Netherlands.

Help ambitious Swiss businesses expand internationally by removing the complexities of cross-border hiring and workforce management. As an Account Executive, you will own the full B2B sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to negotiation, closing, and successful customer onboarding. You will advise founders, HR leaders, and other decision-makers on workforce solutions that enable them to hire talent across borders compliantly. Working in a remote-first, international sales team, you will build a strong pipeline, develop strategic relationships, and turn complex business challenges into commercial opportunities. This role is designed for a results-driven sales professional who combines consultative selling with proactive outbound prospecting and confident deal management. You will have the autonomy to manage your territory, exceed ambitious sales targets, and contribute to the growth of a globally connected business.


Accountabilities:

Take ownership of the complete sales process across assigned Swiss accounts, building a strong pipeline and helping companies understand the value of international workforce solutions. Work closely with prospects and internal sales colleagues to identify business needs, navigate complex buying processes, and consistently achieve commercial objectives.

  • Manage the full sales cycle, from initial prospecting and discovery through qualification, negotiation, closing, and successful customer onboarding.

  • Develop and manage relationships with Swiss companies seeking to expand internationally and hire talent across borders.

  • Conduct thorough discovery conversations to understand hiring plans, business priorities, expansion timelines, and potential compliance risks.

  • Engage founders, HR leaders, and other key stakeholders, building internal champions and demonstrating the business value of proposed solutions to Finance, Legal, and executive decision-makers.

  • Apply structured qualification methodologies, such as MEDDICC, to assess opportunities, prioritize qualified prospects, and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.

  • Generate new business through proactive outbound activities, including cold calling, personalized outreach, and targeted prospecting around relevant business events and funding announcements.

  • Collaborate with Business Development Representatives (BDRs) to identify and pursue high-value opportunities within the assigned territory.

  • Maintain deal momentum through effective follow-ups, confident negotiations, and clear communication throughout the buying process.

  • Use AI tools to improve prospect research, outreach quality, productivity, and sales execution.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date CRM records, including pipeline activity, opportunity progress, and sales forecasts.

  • Consistently meet or exceed sales quotas while taking accountability for individual performance and continuously improving through feedback.

  • Contribute to team knowledge-sharing, collaborate with colleagues across international markets, and apply lessons learned from successful and unsuccessful deals.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate is a proactive, commercially minded sales professional with proven B2B SaaS closing experience and the confidence to engage senior decision-makers. You should combine strong discovery and qualification skills with a willingness to prospect independently, manage complex sales conversations, and deliver measurable results in a fast-paced, remote environment.

    • At least 1 year of experience closing B2B SaaS deals as an Account Executive, with a demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas.

    • Ability to substantiate sales performance with clear metrics, including quota attainment and closed-won results.

    • Native-level Swiss German proficiency and business-fluent English for the Swiss German-speaking profile; alternatively, fluency in both German and French for the German- and French-speaking profile.

    • Strong discovery, qualification, and consultative selling skills, with experience using methodologies such as MEDDICC.

    • Confidence and persistence in outbound sales, including cold calling, personalized prospecting, and engaging busy founders and senior stakeholders.

    • Ability to uncover customer needs, communicate business value, address objections, and navigate complex decision-making processes.

    • Strong negotiation and closing skills, with a proactive approach to maintaining deal momentum and achieving sales targets.

    • Familiarity with AI-powered tools and the ability to integrate them into daily sales workflows.

    • Experience using HubSpot or a comparable CRM, with strong organizational skills and consistent data hygiene.

    • Coachability, adaptability, and a willingness to seek feedback and implement improvements quickly.

    • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and time-management skills in a distributed working environment.

    • An existing professional network among Swiss founders or HR leaders is an advantage.

    • Previous experience in HR technology, payroll, Employer of Record (EOR), or other compliance-intensive solutions is a plus.

    • Additional French language skills are beneficial for engaging customers in French-speaking Switzerland.

    • Creativity and resourcefulness in identifying new ways to reach decision-makers and generate qualified opportunities.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive compensation starting from €50,000 gross annual on-target earnings (OTE), comprising 60% base salary and 40% variable bonus, depending on location, skills, and experience.

      • Fully remote working arrangement within approximately two hours of Central European Time (CET).

      • WorkFlex program offering flexibility to work from different locations, subject to applicable policies.

      • Dedicated Well-Being Day to rest, recharge, and support personal well-being.

      • Subsidized gym memberships to support physical health and an active lifestyle.

      • Training and Development Allowance to support continuous learning and professional growth.

      • Annual team meetups to build relationships and strengthen collaboration across the distributed team.

      • Opportunity to work with an international sales organization spanning Europe, Africa, and the Middle East.

      • Collaborative, performance-oriented culture that encourages knowledge-sharing, constructive feedback, and collective success.

      • Commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equal employment opportunities.

      • Benefits may vary depending on the employee's location and applicable local regulations.

Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken Customer

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimising resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

We have been licensing Kraken since 2019. Throughout this time, the Delivery team has been at the forefront of industry-leading migrations, setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like. These transformations go far beyond technology: we work with clients to rethink their operating models and ways of working, while continuously making the most of Kraken's evolving capabilities.

 

Client Delivery sits at the heart of Kraken’s transformation journeys, at the intersection of our clients and the product and engineering teams building Kraken 🚀 We lead conversations around our clients’ most important needs, help them unlock the value of Kraken and turn complex challenges into opportunities to evolve the platform, keeping Kraken innovative, relevant and ahead of where the energy market is going.

 

It’s a high-impact, hands-on team where you’ll influence both how our clients transform and what Kraken becomes next 💡 You’ll work alongside other Client Delivery Leads (across the same client and areas of expertise) as well as Transformation Directors and Technical Programme Leads, bringing together the right perspectives to challenge thinking, drive change and deliver the best possible outcomes for our clients.

 

🚀 What you'll own:

  • As a Client Delivery Lead you will be at the forefront of the transformation journey with our clients.

  • You will be managing the relationship with client counterparts (often product owners and business owners).

  • You will have full ownership of a domain or product area for your client and act as a key point of contact for technology development and issue resolution within your domain or product area.

  • You will build a deep understanding of Kraken, as well as client needs and priorities, to provide expert advice and identify the best solutions, balancing the use of existing Kraken capabilities with the need for custom-built solutions.

  • You will triage and prioritise incoming requests, clearly articulating client needs, priorities and timelines to the right Kraken teams to support effective delivery and the ongoing development of the platform.

  • You will work closely with product managers and developers to translate client needs into clear priorities and support the delivery of product features.

  • You will challenge clients to think differently about technology development, championing Kraken's iterative approach and shared platform over bespoke solutions.

  • You will be committed to the Kraken way of delivering tech based on simplicity, client benefit and efficiency while bringing stakeholders through a journey of change.

 

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • Strong client delivery, product ownership/management experience, including client-facing (often senior) stakeholder management.

  • Experience managing technology products, migration/implementation projects or complex delivery in an agile environment.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to translate complex client needs into clear action-plans and impactful solutions.

  • Excellent communication, collaboration and influencing skills, with the confidence to challenge traditional ways of thinking and drive change

  • Experience navigating complex delivery pipelines, competing priorities and changing environments.

  • A proactive, adaptable and hands-on mindset, willing to roll your sleeves up to solve any problem, frequently flexing outside of your typical job role to drive progress for our clients and organization.

  • Resilience and empathy, staying positive and persistent through challenges while understanding the human impact of transformation and supporting clients through change with patience and sensitivity.

  • We are a flat and agile organisation and plan to remain this way. We are looking for open-minded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity and an ever-changing environment.

⭐ Bonus points:

  • Consulting experience.

  • Experience with large-scale technology transformations, migrations or enterprise platforms.

  • Experience in energy, utilities or another regulated or complex industry.

 

We are building a Kraken for everyone, a universal platform where there is greater benefit in sharing development to enable the green energy transition. Pioneers in this space, we are excited about how Kraken can change the lives of our customers and convinced that Kraken is the best answer, not only for efficiency but as a tool to tackle the climate crisis. If you believe this too then Kraken Tech is the right place for you.

Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have the right tools and environment to unleash your potential. If you have any accommodation requests, please contact us at ----- We’ll do our best to tailor the experience to your needs so you can feel comfortable, confident and be at your best!

Studies have shown that some groups of people, like women, are less likely to apply to a role unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we’re looking for! At Kraken, we're creating a team of genuine, honest, empathetic people. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. We consider all applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

These policies explain how we handle your data and outline your rights under applicable laws, including, but not limited to, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete your information, object to processing, or withdraw consent. By applying, you acknowledge that you’ve read, understood and consent to these terms
